description: We are a team of students participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. We are passionate about space, science, and technology. Our goal is to explore NASA’s challenges, develop creative solutions, and learn through teamwork. We value creativity, research, problem-solving, and collaboration, and we are excited to turn our ideas into an innovative project!
summary: Abandoned but not Forgotten is an interactive space storytelling website that brings the forgotten stories of NASA's lunar and Martian exploration equipment to life. Through two immersive worlds, the Moon and Mars, visitors can discover six historic machines, understand their missions, explore their journeys and learn why they were left behind. Guided by Orbi, a friendly space explorer, users can experience mission stories, historical timelines, equipment information and the scientific discoveries these machines made possible. The project combines space exploration, educational storytelling and interactive web experiences to make NASA's space history engaging and accessible, especially for younger audiences. It aims to remind people that even when a mission ends, its discoveries continue to shape humanity's exploration of space.
details:
Project Overview

Abandoned but not Forgotten is an interactive educational storytelling experience developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 challenge, "Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars."

The Problem

Space missions leave behind equipment on the Moon and Mars after completing their intended objectives. Although these machines played important roles in exploration and scientific discovery, their stories are not always easy for younger audiences to understand or explore.

Our Solution

We developed an interactive website that presents the stories of six historic exploration machines across two environments: the Moon and Mars. Visitors can explore the equipment, learn about its original purpose, follow mission timelines, discover scientific contributions and understand why the machines were left behind.

Interactive Experience

Orbi, our friendly space guide, introduces visitors to the equipment and narrates its journey. The website combines visual storytelling, mission information, timelines and interactive exploration to make space history easier and more engaging to understand.

Educational Impact

The project aims to make NASA's exploration history accessible to younger audiences, encourage curiosity about planetary science and highlight the lasting scientific value of missions even after their equipment stops operating.

Technology

The website was developed using HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with AI-assisted development tools. The project uses NASA-related information and credited resources to support its educational content.

Our Goal

Our goal is to show that abandoned space equipment is not simply forgotten machinery. Each object represents a mission, a scientific achievement and a step forward in humanity's exploration of the universe.
